scope: prime-weight discovery and one-damping W33 tower falsifier

prime_cocycle_identity.small_delta_limit: P(a,delta)/delta^2 -> 4 L''(2a), a positive log-prime-square moment

convergence.interpretation: the naive positive prime lift cannot be placed directly on sigma=1; explicit-formula regularization is mandatory

single_damping_tower.verdict: prime damping repairs much of the rigid W33 moment mismatch, but one exponent cannot reproduce xi beyond S4

proved: an exact positive von-Mangoldt second-difference identity in its convergence half-plane
the sigma=1 naive sum is outside that convergence half-plane
the one-damping prime tower fails an out-of-sample sextic moment
not_proved: a regularized prime/zero equality at sigma=1
an operator determinant equal to xi
